MSI Modern 14 (C7M-062IN) is the best value at ₹43,219: it's the only one under ₹50,000 with a Ryzen 5 and 16 GB RAM.

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM / storage	Screen
MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN	₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16 GB / 512 GB SSD	14 inch
Acer Aspire Lite AL15-41	₹42,990	Ryzen 5 5625U	8 GB / 512 GB SSD	15 inch
Acer Travel Lite TL14-42M	₹49,999	Ryzen 3 7330U	16 GB / 512 GB SSD	14 inch
The Acer Aspire Lite is the cheapest, but it has an older chip and only 8 GB RAM.
The Acer Travel Lite has 16 GB, but it costs ₹6,780 more than the MSI and has a weaker processor.
The MSI first came out in Mar 2023, so it may be hard to find in stock.

Prices are from Smartprix, updated Tue 27 Oct 2026. Screen sizes come from the names. The page doesn't give screen quality, so check that before you buy.
